notes.title: Japanese Patch Update
notes.notes:
The Japanese patch is now live. 

You can now enjoy the story and dialogues in Japanese for a richer experience. 
I’ve also fixed several script errors to ensure a more stable gameplay environment. 
Check out the update and dive into a new adventure!

notes.title: Revive Patch Update - English Support Added! (March 28, 2025)
notes.notes:
Hello Revive players!

We’re excited to announce a new patch for Revive:
- Added English language support
- Fixed an error with scene transition effects

Additionally, a Japanese language translation update is scheduled for April.

Thank you for your support!

//PlayWriter
